segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר: כׇּל הַכֵּלִים נִיטָּלִין, חוּץ מִן הַמַּסָּר הַגָּדוֹל וְיָתֵד שֶׁל מַחֲרֵישָׁה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Rabbi Yosei says: All utensils may be moved» on Shabbat «except for a large saw and the blade of a plow.» Since they must be sharp and ready for use and there is concern that they might be damaged, one sets them aside from his consciousness and they may not be used for any other purpose.

moves.summary: all utensils may be moved except large saw and plow blade
moves.about: whether all utensils may be moved on Shabbat, or a large saw and plow blade are excluded

positions.claim: all utensils may be moved except a large saw and a plow blade
positions.basis: one sets them aside for fear of damage

unresolved.issue: which anonymous view R' Yosei opposes is not stated in the unit; dispute with the 122b mishna is inferred
